description.zh:
自定义用户ID。用于存档的读取和保存。最大长度不超过64个字符。
> 当应用类型为`end_game`、`hand_game`时，本参数必填。
description.en:
Custom User ID. Used for reading from and saving to archives. The maximum length is 64 characters.
> This parameter is Required when the application Type is `end_game` or `hand_game`.

Custom session ID.

description.en: Rule information for resource matching. Multiple rules are supported; the more rules specified, the longer the Duration required to find a suitable resource.

descriptions.zh: 当批量创建会话的个数不同时，时效性不同。最多一次批量创建20个。
descriptions.en: Timeliness varies depending on the number of sessions created in a batch. You can create up to 20 sessions in a single batch.
